text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*munch*... *munch*... *sigh*...
Yup, these haskaps really are top-tier...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for sharing! Glad this tasting session
proved helpful for you.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You ordered over the phone, right? The lady running it is an old
family friend. She was so happy when I moved to Tokyo.
She even had business cards made for me...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah! No, no! Nothing serious at all! Totally fine!

...Looking at the past few days, it seems like a real issue.
Maybe the reason behind it is――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I'm the star of Tomakomai!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? How do you know about that――
choice_data_list: Because that's the kind of atmosphere you make……

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...No way. I didn't even notice...
So, whenever you run into trouble, feel free to talk to me, okay?
She began to talk in hushed tones, as if she had given up on everything.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...I've lived in Tomakomai for as long as I can remember. It's a town with the scent of the sea breeze and a vast, open sky."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "On my days off, I'd go down to the harbor to watch the big ferry boats come in, ride my bike to the park, play by the lake..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Spending my days like that, I started noticing the town slowly changing, little by little."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Shuttered storefronts that never opened anymore, dusty show windows... The town was quietly fading away."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "It shocked me. I knew the word 'depopulation', but... it really hit me: 'Our town is going through it too.'"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I was scared that if things went on like this, everything would just disappear..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I couldn't just stand by and do nothing, so I started working as a locodol."

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Local
text_block_list.text: A locodol, as in a local idol...? Hmm. So, like... a poster girl or something?

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly! I was thinking I could sing and dance to catch people's attention, you know?

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But if I just perform on the street, only the locals will ever see it. I'm worried about where I should be doing this...

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Local
text_block_list.text: Well then, Tarumae-chan, we've got the perfect place for you. A special stage where only Umamusume can stand!

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Representing Tomakomai, I'm Hokko Tarumae! I'll be singing "Come on, Tomakomai!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I joined a local junior team and began running in races. I did post-race concerts to promote Tomakomai, and the response was pretty good—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Then one day, a racing official from Tokyo approached me."

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "..."If you enroll at Tracen Academy and run in the Twinkle Series, you can promote Tomakomai to way more people than you ever could here"... huh?"

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...Tracen Academy. I hadn't thought about it before... but—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I thought, 'This is my chance.' The Twinkle Series was our chance to promote Tomakomai nationwide!"

text_block_list.name: Younger Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I have to do my best...! I want everyone out there to know about Tomakomai...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "From then on, I trained with everything I had and passed the entrance exam for Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I'll do my absolute best! I'm definitely going to make Tomakomai thrive!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah. I really tried so hard..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "Yet the harder I tried, the worse things went, both in my races and as a locodol."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "...Everyone back in Tomakomai gave me such a warm send-off. They gave me this sash and business cards, putting all their hopes in me..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "If I don't step up, another shop might close, and Tomakomai might shrink even more."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "And yet... I haven't accomplished a single thing...!"
choice_data_list: …… I think, you are overthinking this.

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "I see... She's working so hard to make her dream come true, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text: "We can't let ourselves lose either! In fact, she inspired us so much that we started running our own social media recently."
Thinking I should show her what they were doing, I searched on social media and found a site with a fresh, lively look.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ............Blog updates, an online store launch, regular local events...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wow, so many people...! They're even collaborating with city hall for this event...! To think they were doing all this—...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There's a blog post written about me... "Regarding Hokko Tarumae, Tomakomai's Locodol."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I hope she's staying healthy in Tokyo. She was always so eager to revitalize Tomakomai, but I worry she might be carrying too heavy a burden on her shoulders."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "..."As long as you're doing well, that's what matters most. Leave the hometown to us!" That's what I want to tell her the next time she visits."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "To everyone who meets her in Tokyo, please look after her. Please take good care of our pride and joy, Hokko Tarumae."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I'm such a fool...! I was taking them for granted...! As if Tomakomai could ever be carried by just one person...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The sash, the business cards... all those kind words. They weren't burdening me—they were cheering on my dream the entire time...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Just to help me reach my dream...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What are you doing, Tarumae?! Pull yourself together, Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The people of Tomakomai are so kind! They've been cheering for my dream from the bottom of their hearts!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That's why... that's why! I have to give it my all for Tomakomai! I'll put Tomakomai on the map no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-san! Will you become my trainer and guide my training?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I want to win the next mock race, without fail. I want to win and become someone who can make everyone in Tomakomai truly proud!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: So I need to build real strength... I need professional guidance!
And with that, I officially signed a contract with Hokko Tarumae.
